title: Same fixed family with a degree-sensitive certificate and half of its preceding complete loss

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total certificate-prefix language specified in proof.md and the evaluator in audit.py. Output 0 for N=0 or the explicit failed guards in proof.md. The output is the constant coefficient in F_2[Z]/Q. claims: The universal additive constant8 in C_B2(f)>=4n-8d+8 for every n and d>=3 under the affine-disperser hypothesis is sharp: h(x,y,u,v,z)=xy XOR uv XOR z has circuit size exactly four and no monochromatic affine three-flat at n=5,d=3. The complete generic lower bound is in refinement.md; Appendix B.3 of proof.md proves this matching example. This asserts sharpness of this finite universal additive constant, not of a leading coefficient.

experiments.purpose: Exactly regenerate and check the unrestricted84-state and complete six-variable Ramsey refutations, the retained read-once cover, both near-read-once seven-variable covers, the four-pair eight-variable cover, the full six-variable exceptional-tail classification and all reverse A/C/E2 predecessor covers. These are finite obligations in the supplied universal4m-8d+8 proof; standard-library only, no external solver or previous verdict. Also compare exact sharpened/coarse integer certificate parameters at selected actual lengths. The general block-selection, Boolean-degree bridge and degree-sensitive circuit bound are supplied mathematical proofs, not inferred from sampled lengths.
